title: Charges and crunches
note: A charge guards like Scales while it draws. A one-slot charge releases next slot with no bonus; scripting the same charge again holds it a second slot, and that release earns +3. A hit during a charging slot breaks it. A crunch puts two attacks in one slot, 15 ticks each, with no modifiers; it needs Raking Talons (Claw) or Gnashing Teeth (Bite). Brine holds a Bite charge two slots and lands it, then starts a Breath charge that Coil, a crunchling with Raking Talons, breaks with a crunch of its claws.
